title: UP031 fix produces unbalanced parentheses when the format string is wrapped in two or more parentheses
author: mati-caliz
body_preview: When the format string is wrapped in two or more levels of parentheses, e.g. `(("%s")) % (x,)`, the UP031 fix rewrites it to `(("{}"))).format(x)`, with one extra closing parenthesis. With `--unsafe-fixes`, ruff detects the syntax error and reverts all fixes in the file, so none of them get applied, including the valid ones.
